How to Use the Hub
The Hub brings authoritative and data-driven initiatives to life by combining data, visualization, analytics, and collaboration technology to enable governments and citizens to work together on real-world initiatives that tackle everyday challenges and the most pressing issues in their communities.
ArcGIS Hub transforms how we engage and collaborate with our community using data-driven tools for innovation.
